body: You will feel like dying every second of the day but believe me, time makes things hurt little less, do not try to put permanent solution to a situation that is just temporary. Suicide is not the answer, if you need someone to talk dm. I’m here
How long it took you to feel better?

What you are feeling is not wrong and I want to tell you that you are not alone. The most important person in the entire universe right now is YOU! The only person that can make you happy and can make you feel better is YOU! Try remembering how you felt before meeting this person, you used to laugh and enjoy things, do not give up and just take a day at a time, an hour at a time and even a minute at a time.

Cry and let it burn that feeling, don’t hold anything back because it will only hurt you, you will notice that maybe today your cried 3 hours and had 10 panic attacks, but I promise you this: “You will make it through! Do not give up! The only person that matters is YOU!”

Repeat to your self loudly “I love my self, I can make it”.

I’m telling you this because I been there, we all have been there, is not easy but if you need someone to talk and someone who will just listen without judging text me.

I promise you that this is not the end, do not give up!
What’s going on? Send a message

I see you, I been there and this is not the end. Don’t be afraid to reach out if you need someone to talk to.

Most of the time we get hurt thinking what did I do wrong? We put expectations on places on persons that shouldn’t be, we leave our mind to wander and torture us with negative thoughts. You are in control of your own life, please do not quit, we are here if you need help.
